spec.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(tm.layer, '(sem layer)') AS metric, count(i.ingestion_id) AS total FROM ingestions i LEFT JOIN ingestions_table_metadata tm ON tm.ingestion_id = i.ingestion_id AND tm.version = i.active_version GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(o.sys_name, '(sem origem)') AS metric, count(i.ingestion_id) AS total FROM ingestions i LEFT JOIN ingestions_table_metadata tm ON tm.ingestion_id = i.ingestion_id AND tm.version = i.active_version LEFT JOIN origins o ON o.sys_id = tm.origin GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(tm.periodicity, '(sem periodicidade)') AS metric, count(i.ingestion_id) AS total FROM ingestions i LEFT JOIN ingestions_table_metadata tm ON tm.ingestion_id = i.ingestion_id AND tm.version = i.active_version GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(tm.security_classification, '(sem classificação)') AS metric, count(i.ingestion_id) AS total FROM ingestions i LEFT JOIN ingestions_table_metadata tm ON tm.ingestion_id = i.ingestion_id AND tm.version = i.active_version GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;
SELECT p.pii_name AS metric, count(*) AS total FROM ingestions_columns_metadata c JOIN pii_types p ON p.pii_id = c.pii_id WHERE c.pii_id IS NOT NULL AND c.pii_id != 1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT i.ingestion_id AS "ID", i.status AS "Status", COALESCE(s.name, '—') AS "Sigla", i.created_at::text AS "Criada em", COALESCE(tm.table_name, '—') AS "Tabela", COALESCE(tm.layer, '—') AS "Layer", COALESCE(tm.origin_format, '—') AS "Formato", COALESCE(tm.periodicity, '—') AS "Periodicidade" FROM ingestions i LEFT JOIN siglas s ON s.sigla_id = i.sigla_id LEFT JOIN ingestions_table_metadata tm ON tm.ingestion_id = i.ingestion_id AND tm.version = i.active_version ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, i.ingestion_id DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT s.name AS "Sigla", COALESCE(u.email, u.full_name, '—') AS "Owner" FROM siglas s LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.owner_id ORDER BY s.name;
SELECT count(*) AS "Sucesso" FROM ingestions WHERE status = 'SUCCESS';
SELECT count(*) AS "Erros" FROM ingestions WHERE status = 'FAILED';
SELECT count(*) AS "Pendentes" FROM ingestions WHERE status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL';
SELECT count(*) AS "Vencidas" FROM ingestions WHERE status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' AND should_be_approved_until < CURRENT_DATE;
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCESS') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED')), 0), 1) AS "Taxa de sucesso" FROM ingestions;
SELECT created_at::timestamp AS time, count(*) AS "Cadastradas" FROM ingestions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at::timestamp) GROUP BY created_at ORDER BY 1;
SELECT created_at::timestamp AS time, status AS metric, count(*) AS total FROM ingestions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at::timestamp) GROUP BY created_at, status ORDER BY 1;
SELECT COALESCE(s.name, '(sem sigla)') AS metric, count(i.ingestion_id) AS total FROM ingestions i LEFT JOIN siglas s ON s.sigla_id = i.sigla_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;
